summary: e2fsprogs_alignment64_hosttest.c, the buffer alignment of e2fsprogs' unix_io.c through pread64 and pwrite64, with a fault in buffer-alignment.patch, which the build applies to an extraction of its own; the headers that e2fsprogs' build generates come from the tree's extraction

argv:
set -e
t=${WORK}/tree
rm -rf "$t"
mkdir -p "$t/vendor/e2fsprogs/patches" "$t/tests/host/compat"
tar -xzf vendor/e2fsprogs/e2fsprogs-1.47.4.tar.gz -C "$t/vendor/e2fsprogs" e2fsprogs-1.47.4/lib/ext2fs
cp vendor/e2fsprogs/patches/* "$t/vendor/e2fsprogs/patches/"
cp -R ${SRC}/. "$t/"
while IFS= read -r p; do
    case $p in ''|'#'*) continue ;; esac
    patch -s -d "$t/vendor/e2fsprogs/e2fsprogs-1.47.4" -p1 <"$t/vendor/e2fsprogs/patches/$p"
done <"$t/vendor/e2fsprogs/patches/series"
cp -R tests/host/compat/e2fsprogs "$t/tests/host/compat/"
cp tests/host/e2fsprogs_alignment64_hosttest.c "$t/tests/host/"
cd "$t"
exec ${CC:-cc} -std=c99 -g -O1 -Wno-empty-body -ffreestanding -fsanitize=address,undefined -fno-sanitize-recover=all -I tests/host/compat/e2fsprogs -I vendor/e2fsprogs/e2fsprogs-1.47.4/lib -I ${TREE}/vendor/e2fsprogs/e2fsprogs-1.47.4/lib -o ${WORK}/e2fsprogs_alignment64_hosttest tests/host/e2fsprogs_alignment64_hosttest.c

faults.name: is-aligned
faults.summary: upstream's check of the buffer's address, which sends a misaligned buffer through the bounce path

lines: e2fsprogs_alignment64_hosttest: fail: misaligned read uses one whole call
e2fsprogs_alignment64_hosttest: fail: misaligned write uses one whole call
